VITE_API_BASE_URL (not VITE_API_URL) is also read by 6 more modules that each build their own client: features/auth/authApiClient.ts:10, features/buildings/hooks/useBuildings.ts:19, features/messaging/hooks/useMessaging.ts:38, features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:15, features/registry/pages/RegistryRulesPage.tsx:16, features/neighbors/hooks/useNeighbors.ts:31.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/vite-env.d.ts:3-13 — ImportMetaEnv declares VITE_API_URL (and VITE_WS_URL, VITE_API_DEFAULT) but NOT VITE_API_BASE_URL, so every VITE_API_BASE_URL read is untyped and a typo in the var name is invisible to tsc.

IMPACT: the app resolves its API base from TWO divergent env vars with divergent fallbacks ('/api/v1' and '' for VITE_API_URL vs '' for VITE_API_BASE_URL). In a deploy that follows the documented prod convention (VITE_API_URL set to an absolute API host) but leaves VITE_API_BASE_URL unset, AuthContext login/refresh/logout and the buildings/messaging/registry/neighbors clients silently fall back to '' (same-origin relative) and send requests to the WEB origin instead of the API host -> broken auth + broken features, while the rest of the app (axios client + generated client) correctly uses the absolute host. Benign only when web and API share an origin.

FIX: consolidate on one canonical var (VITE_API_URL) across AuthContext + the 6 feature modules (or alias VITE_API_BASE_URL -> VITE_API_URL in one shared accessor), and declare the canonical key in ImportMetaEnv so tsc guards future typos.
